definitions.gloss: timid; faint-hearted; unable to assert oneself
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who cannot say no, backs down under pressure, or is easily rattled. The judgment is usually mildly critical or self-deprecating rather than harsh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{弱|よわ}い。
{気|き}が{弱|よわ}くて⟦{断|ことわ}れなかった→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: I was too faint-hearted to say no.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ほど、⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けて→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧しまいがちだ。
examples.english: The more timid a person is, the more likely they are to take on impossible work.

notes:
A fixed ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ expression: the subject of ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ is ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧, so the person takes ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ in a double-subject pattern (⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{弱|よわ}い). In attributive position the ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ becomes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a timid person (attributive form)
- {気|き}が{弱|よわ}くて⟦{断|ことわ}れない→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: too timid to refuse
- {気|き}が{弱|よわ}そう: to look faint-hearted

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{強|つよ}い→気が強い：30270_kigatsuyoi⟧: strong-willed, assertive — the direct opposite
- ⟦{臆病|おくびょう}→臆病：07608_okubyou⟧な: cowardly — about fear itself, stronger and more negative
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧な: shy, reserved — about reticence with people, not about caving in to pressure
